gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Rounded, bold, and cut open at the ends. Gugi lets its lowercase nearly touch the capitals, while Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely above lowercase with distinctly open mouths, so extended reading moves smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Gugi draws round, bold letters with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki goes the other way, its lowercase swollen like tightly coiled rope, with apertures that stay open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Bold, uniform lines with no swelling anywhere. Noto Sans Brahmi follows with a high mean line and open-ended curves, which keeps extended reading light beside the weight of Gugi.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Curves locked to their stems. Gugi supplies the bold display punch, while Noto Sans Buhid adds generous space between curve ends and stems plus a high-set x-height guide underneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-carian: Gugi locks curves and stems together, a bold display face that looks distinctive from the first glance. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart, so long text flows cleanly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cham: A w with no thick or thin strokes gives Gugi its distinctive, bold look. Noto Sans Cham brings an open c and rounded lowercase, so shrinking Gugi too far would let the body win.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Distinctive and bold, Gugi traces every letter as if with one marker. Noto Sans Cherokee adds a high band of letters with short stalks and a wide-gapped e, giving the heavy heading room to breathe.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Lines that hold their thickness from start to finish define Gugi, a bold and distinctive display face. And Noto Sans Chorasmian supplies the relief, with a large x-height, short ascenders and curves that stop short of closing.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Gugi skims along on stroke weight that never changes, a bold and distinctive display face. Noto Sans Coptic fills each line with a dominant middle zone and open mouths on its s and c, so paragraphs read cleanly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Gugi stays bold, with counters framed by same-width strokes. It handles display punch best, while Noto Sans Cuneiform handles text, its e opening up and its lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads.
